EV-000911

Packing 18 unit squares in the smallest square · Packing · status current

Definition

s(18) = the smallest side of a square that contains 18 non-overlapping squares of side 1.

s(18)=\min\{s:\ 18\text{ interior-disjoint unit squares fit in }[0,s]^2\}

Domain: arrangements of unit squares (rotations allowed) in a square. Normalisation: side length of the square; squares have side 1; a trailing '+' marks a decimal printed truncated (true value slightly larger). Direction: min.

Current value

4.82287565553229+ (record)
